Indicator!operator_warning.fallbackLabel: WARNING: the buttons below call services on the running system. Use them in mock mode only. On the robot, the GUI and the RC are the operator.

CallService!grant.buttonTooltip: Calls /act/system/command with command 3 (GRANT): the arbiter gives every pending request to its client.

CallService!request_arm.buttonTooltip: The MC asks for drive, lift and vibe. Then press GRANT.

CallService!clear_error.buttonTooltip: SM ERROR -> IDLE. Clears the loaded plan.

CallService!green_light.buttonTooltip: Only in READY_TO_START. The MC starts the print segment.

CallService!cut_done.buttonTooltip: Only in WAITING_TO_RETURN. The MC starts the return segment.
